revisions.summary: Initial specification. Defines the file header, tile table and metadata blocks; the universal block header and its recovery tags; the array and byte-array primitives; layer extents and tile offsets; attributes, associated images, ICC colour profiles and annotations. Establishes little-endian dense packing, the derived-offset rule, and the append-only versioning invariant.

Adds focal-plane support (Z_PLANES on the layer extent entry, MICRONS_PLANE spacing), a configurable tile edge length (TILE_LENGTH), a self-describing tile frame (optional, except on a Z-stacked layer), a clinical metadata block reached by a new METADATA offset, carrying a stream whose serialization -- HL7 v2, FHIR as JSON, or FastFHIR -- is declared by an ENCODING field rather than inferred from the bytes, and redefines METADATA_I2S as Iris Interoperability Specification conformance. The two metadata channels divide by shape as well as by subject: laboratory metadata is key-value and stays in the attribute arrays under I2S or DICOM, while the clinical resource graph goes in the stream. Only the stream carries identity, so a slide is de-identified by dropping it alone. Retires IMAGE_ENCODING_PNG and ANNOTATION_PNG through the new deprecated marking (decided 2026-11-24, so readers and writers implement fewer encodings): their values stay assigned, writers shall not emit them, a reader may refuse one by naming it, and SVG is the preferred annotation encoding. States that patient identity belongs only in the clinical metadata stream, under every attribute FORMAT (decided 2026-11-24, so that dropping the stream alone de-identifies the slide); METADATA_I2S attributes hold only facts of the slide fixed when it was scanned. Reassigns tile encoding value 3 from AVIF to TILE_ENCODING_AV1 (decided 2026-11-25; the value is reassigned in place rather than deprecated because no file in use carries the AVIF tile encoding): the tile byte-stream is a bare AV1 sequence in the Low Overhead Bitstream Format with no container, one shown frame per focal plane, and a single-plane tile is one key frame. IMAGE_ENCODING_AVIF, the associated-image encoding, is unchanged.
